name: Hungarosaurus
sum: Hungarosaurus is a nodosaurid from the Santonian Csehbánya Formation of Hungary, with four known specimens, the best a skeleton of 450 bones.
wsnote: Length of mature specimens (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: MTM Gyn/404, about 450 bones including parts of the skull — open-pit bauxite mine near Iharkút, Bakony Mountains, Hungary.
material: Three more specimens from the same locality.
biology: Walked on four legs with hundreds of osteoderms; tooth wear and chewing cycle have been studied (Ősi et al.).
author: Osi 2005

images.artist: Attila Ősi, Paul M. Barrett, Tamás Földes, Richárd Tokai
images.caption: Teeth of Hungarosaurus (Ősi et al. 2014).
